operational_state_migration.rationale: Canonical state was merged, but the target-owned 500-work execution, reconciliation, continuation and recovery proof was not dispatched and remains blocked.

corpus_custody_recoverability.rationale: A deterministic local package exists, while rights, remote authority, independent recovery and Prompt 10 acceptance remain unsatisfied.

publication_identity_migration.rationale: Zenodo identity is corrected read-only, but Hugging Face target-originated publication remains a candidate awaiting external approval.

derived_outputs.rationale: Generated from the index and therefore recorded without a self-referential hash; the output binds the exact index SHA-256.
